problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 5 cargo shipments through 5 specialized port terminals.

Each shipment must pass through a fixed sequence of terminal processing stages represented as (Terminal, Hours),
where each pair specifies the terminal where processing occurs and the duration required.
The order of pairs indicates the mandatory sequence in which terminals must process the shipment.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (T1, 1) → (T2, 3) → (T4, 2) → (T5, 7) → (T3, 4)
* S2 follows the route: (T5, 4) → (T4, 6) → (T3, 10) → (T1, 2) → (T2, 10)
* S3 follows the route: (T1, 5) → (T3, 1) → (T2, 9) → (T4, 1) → (T5, 4)
* S4 follows the route: (T3, 4) → (T1, 5) → (T4, 5) → (T2, 5) → (T5, 9)
* S5 follows the route: (T4, 1) → (T3, 5) → (T2, 9) → (T5, 2) → (T1, 1)

Each terminal processing stage must run continuously once initiated and cannot be paused,
and each terminal can only handle one shipment processing stage at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all shipment stages across the terminals
so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
